releaseNotes: Multi-Screen & Variable DPI Architecture: Dual-layout engine with auto-switching between Ultra-Dense Browser Mode (<360px) and Spacious Stadium Mode (>=360px)
Split-Flank South Zone: Deadwood meter and Turn Timer moved to Left Flank, Discard/Gin to Right Flank, freeing 40px of vertical space and preventing card collisions
4-Way Compass Edge-Docking: Opponents distributed naturally around all 4 table edges (West on Left, East on Right, North at Top Center)
iPhone Safari PWA Fullscreen Support: Replaced non-working HTML5 fullscreen icon on iPhone with dedicated gold '📲 Fullscreen App' badge and 2-step Home Screen guide sheet
Fluid Card Clamping: Hand cards and table piles dynamically scale down to fit tight toolbar-constrained viewports with zero clipping
